questions.q: What does an RMSSE below 1 mean?
options: The forecast is worse than naive
The forecast beats the in-sample one-step naive error
By share of recent dollar sales within each level

questions.q: Series revenues in a level: 30, 10, 60. What is the weight of the first series?
Why use a tweedie loss for M5?
options: Sales are non-negative counts with many zeros
It is the only loss in LightGBM

questions.q: Scenario: you forecast 28 days with a direct model. Which lag is invalid?
why: Correct: lag 14 is unknown for later days.

questions.q: A product has no sell_price in a week. What does it usually mean?
options: The product was not sold in that store yet
A data error to fill with the mean
why: Filling it would teach false sales.

questions.q: Why can the total level have a lower RMSSE than bottom levels?
options: Errors of independent series partly cancel when summed
